exposure: infants of mothers with pregestational diabetes
infants of mothers with gestational diabetes
cohort: 45 infants of diabetic mothers (20 with pregestational diabetes and 25 with gestational diabetes) and 45 healthy newborns
finding: Infants of diabetic mothers had significantly impaired systolic and diastolic function, higher septal/posterior wall ratio, and impaired cardiac torsion and global strain compared to healthy newborns.
